title: Topic 2.2: Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems

pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 2.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: SIMPLE POEMS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: where necessary. How are poems different from other forms of literary genres?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recite a variety of simple poems for enjoyment

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recite a variety of simple poems for enjoyment
   In simple words: practise until you can recite a variety of simple poems for enjoyment. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems.
4. Show that you can: recite a variety of simple poems for enjoyment

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 2.2.1 Intensive reading: Simple poems important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Listen and respond to live or recorded poetry recitation,
2. Discuss what makes reading simple poems interesting,
3. Pick out poems from a variety of texts and read them out aloud,
4. Peace is enhanced as learners work in teams during the poetry recitation.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recite a variety of simple poems for enjoyment

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
